response.justification: Bogdan brings 15+ years of hands-on software development with genuine, relevant depth in developer tooling and testing infrastructure (authored the Trial test runner and Fluent-Asserts library, built and maintained GitLab/CI/deploy infrastructure, taught Selenium/TDD courses, built a mobile device orchestration tool). However, the resume shows no evidence of formal people management — no direct reports, no hiring, no performance reviews or 1:1 ownership — which is an explicit minimum requirement (2 years people management) and the core of this Level II Manager role. Staff-level titles and community teaching suggest informal technical leadership, but the jump to a full people-leadership role would be unproven. Mobile-platform exposure is light (iOS/tvOS work in 2015-16). Worth a screening call only if the hiring bar allows a first-time manager with strong dev-tools credibility; otherwise the management gap is disqualifying.
strengths: Deep, authentic developer-tooling and test-infrastructure portfolio (Trial, Fluent-Asserts, CI/CD, Selenium)
15+ years of broad hands-on engineering — well past the 8-year minimum, strong for code review and system design
Demonstrated mentoring/teaching instinct: workshops, dojos, multi-module courses, conference talks
concerns: No documented people-management experience or direct reports — misses an explicit minimum
No evidence of roadmap ownership, org-level change leadership, or cross-team alignment at scale
Limited and dated mobile-platform experience; no large mobile ecosystem exposure

key_factors.factor: Developer tools and testing infrastructure expertise
